description.narrative: EaP Nätverket arbetar för stärkt samarbete mellan svenska civilsamhällesorganisationer och civilsamhällesorganisationer i Östraparternskapsregionen med syfte att främja demokratisk utveckling, pluralistiska samhällen och samarbete med EU.

The EaP Network works for strengthened cooperation between Swedish civil society organizations and civil society organizations in the Eastern Partnership region with the aim of promoting democratic development, pluralistic societies and cooperation with the EU.

The objective of the intervention is to:
Ensure the sustainability and local ownership of the EaP Network by fostering strategic partnership and enhancing its capacity to support collaboration, advocacy, and the advancement of human rights, democracy, and sustainable development beyond the phase-out period.

The network's success during previous Sida-supported phases lies primarily in the fact that it has succeeded in establishing a network of Swedish civil society organizations with partners in the Eastern Partnership (EaP) countries. These organisations and their partners have to some extent strengthened their capacity through the network's activities.
During this final phase of the Network that is funded by Sida, the focus is on two primary outcomes: expanding and consolidating achievements, and securing long-term sustainability.
Some results reported for the period November 2024 October 2025 are:
With the latest addition of two new member organizations, the Network grew to 39 members. A Sounding Board, and an internal dedicated EaP team at ForumCiv was created, improving the coordination and distribution of key responsibilities.
With a resource mobilization strategy in place, targeted applications and partnership development meetings are a priority in order to secure sustainability beyond the Sida-phase out.
Capacity strengthening initiatives for local partners, on the one hand, and for the Network's members, on the other hand, focused on gender (webinar series), physical/digital security and fundraising, to mention a few examples.
